# {{ external_secrets_operator }} release notes {#external-secrets-operator-release-notes}

The {{ external_secrets_operator }} is a cluster-wide service that provides lifecycle management for secrets fetched from external secret management systems.

These release notes track the development of {{ external_secrets_operator_short }}.

For more information, see [{{ external_secrets_operator_short }} overview](/openshift-docs-markdown/security/external_secrets_operator/index#external-secrets-operator-about).
